title: 第13章 太多了第14章 加入阵营
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: 克琳希德笑靥如花，看得齐格飞一阵心神荡漾。
这个男人虽然平时装的久经情场，但事实上也就是个母胎solo的老处男。之前在审问卡塔丽娜的时候他也只敢探探咸猪手，更过分的事情他没那个色胆。
【提示！您已遭遇本次阶段任务的目标对象之一：克琳希德，请您抓住本次机会完成任务。】
脑海中夏侬的声音惊醒了魂不守舍的齐格飞，他立马收起来自己丢人的猪哥相。对方有可能是自己的未来的老板，还是美少女老板，这不得好好表现表现！
齐格飞收起武器，上前两步来到克琳希德的身前，露出了他作为hRbp职业的儒雅的灿烂的笑容：“克琳希德殿下，在下齐格飞，您的美丽是如此令人惊叹。”
说着他捧起克琳希德修长洁白的手，俯首在指背上轻轻一吻。
这一套动作是那么的行云流水，在所有人还没反应过来时就已经结束了。
这位16岁的公主殿下在原地呆楞了好几秒，这才猛地将手收了回来藏在背后，俏脸红得就像一颗熟透的蜜桃。她连连后退，碧绿的眸子闪动像是一头受惊的小鹿。
（啊咧？）
罗兰的眼睛瞬间就红了，他一把拔出腰间的骑士剑，直接从马上腾空而起挡在克琳希德的身前。
“放肆！你这个无礼的东西，你真以为没人能动得了你吗？“
罗兰持剑的手因暴怒而颤抖，他是真的没想到齐格飞居然如此胆大妄为，居然敢在几十名王国士兵面前公然调戏王女殿下。
（啊咧咧？怎么会是这种反应？）
齐格飞彻底懵逼了。
【提示！摩恩王国并没有吻手礼，您刚刚的行为无异于公然性骚扰一位公主。】
oh……Shit……
【另外正确的吻手礼应该由女方先示意然后才能进行。虽然时间短暂但能和您共事我感到很荣幸，那么，祝您走得安详。】
“你可闭嘴吧！”
周遭的三十多名士兵齐刷刷得举起了手中的长矛。他们已经下定了决心，哪怕今天要拼掉性命也定要将这可恨的厮围杀于此。
“殿下您退后，这厮阴险狡诈说不准还会对您出手。士兵们，包围他！”
罗兰一边护着克琳希德，一边指挥军队开始包围作战。这位久经战阵黄金骑士此刻体现出了自己的老练。
齐格飞看着一点点缩小的包围圈脸色冷了下来。
（看来加入王女阵营是不太可能了。变更计划吧，杀出重围后利用卡塔丽娜诱捕王女克琳希德，以此作为敲门砖加入二王子的阵营。）
齐格飞在一边在心中飞快盘算着，一边寻觅着最薄弱的突破口。
就在千钧一发之际，克琳希德站了出来。
“不，我没事。我只是吓了一跳。罗兰，让士兵们退下吧，梅兰先生并没有恶意。”
“可是他刚才！”
“没关系的，我想梅兰先生只是与我打了个特殊的招呼，没有其他意思。光之精灵们也是这么告诉我的。”
克琳希德走到罗兰的身旁，拍了拍他的肩膀安抚着他。
罗兰这才挥手示意，士兵们有条不紊的收起武器但依旧没有解除包围。
齐格飞松了口气，他刚才都已经做好了最坏的打算。
“请原谅我的无礼，王女殿下。这是奥菲斯帝国最近开始流行的吻手礼，没想到在摩恩并不通用。”
齐格飞一本正经地胡诌着，其实他连奥菲斯帝国在哪个方位都不知道。
克琳希德捂嘴轻笑:
“帝国的风气依旧那么开放呢。”
这张突如其来的插曲虽然惊险，却也快速拉近了两人的距离。
寒暄了两句后，克琳希德端正了面色问道:
“齐格飞先生，卡塔丽娜，我的这位朋友真的在你那儿吗?”
齐格飞环视了一圈附近，看见了某个蹑手蹑脚已经趁乱逃了好远的圃人斥候。
他冷笑一声，指着圃人的方向道:
content_en:
Clinhilde's smile was as bright as a flower, which made Siegfried's heart flutter for a while.
Although this man usually pretends to be in love, he is actually just an old virgin who was born solo. When he was interrogating Catalina before, he only dared to explore her hands, and he didn't have the guts to do something more extreme.
【hint! You have encountered one of the targets of this phase of the mission: Clinhide. Please seize this opportunity to complete the mission. 】
Shannon's voice in his mind woke up the unconscious Siegfried, and he immediately put away his embarrassing pig brother appearance. The other party may be your future boss, or a beautiful girl boss, so you have to show off!
Siegfried put away his weapon, took two steps forward and came to Clinehid, showing his elegant and brilliant smile as a hRbp professional: "Your Highness Clinehid, my majesty, Siegfried, your beauty is so amazing."
As he spoke, he took Clinhide's slender white hand, bent down and kissed the back of her fingers gently.
This set of actions was so smooth and smooth, and it was over before anyone could react.
The 16-year-old princess remained stunned for several seconds before she suddenly took her hand back and hid it behind her back, her pretty face as red as a ripe peach. She backed away continuously, her green eyes flashing like a frightened deer.
(Ah?)
Roland's eyes turned red instantly. He pulled out the knight's sword from his waist, jumped up from his horse and stood in front of Clinthid.
"Presumptuous! You rude thing, do you really think no one can touch you?"
Roland's hand holding the sword trembled with rage. He really didn't expect that Siegfried would be so bold and dare to openly molest Her Royal Highness in front of dozens of Kingdom soldiers.
(Ah? How come this is the reaction?)
Siegfried was completely confused.
【hint! There is no hand kiss in the Kingdom of Morn, and what you just did is tantamount to blatant sexual harassment of a princess. 】
oh...Shit...
[In addition, the correct hand kissing ceremony should be signaled by the woman before proceeding. Although my time was short, I was honored to work with you, so I wish you a peaceful journey. 】
"Shut up!"
More than thirty soldiers around him raised their spears in unison. They have made up their minds, even if they have to risk their lives today, they will definitely surround and kill this hateful guy here.
"Your Highness, please step back. This man may be insidious and cunning and may attack you again. Soldiers, surround him!"
Roland protected Clinhild while commanding the army to begin the encirclement operation. The battle-hardened Golden Knight showed his sophistication at this moment.
Siegfried's face turned cold as he looked at the shrinking circle.
(It seems that joining the princess’s camp is unlikely. Let’s change the plan. After breaking out of the siege, use Katarina to trap the princess Clynchid, and use this as a stepping stone to join the second prince’s camp.)
Siegfried was thinking quickly in his mind while looking for the weakest breakthrough.
At the critical moment, Clinhide stepped forward.
"No, I'm fine. I was just startled. Roland, ask the soldiers to retreat. Mr. Meilan did not mean any harm."
"But he just did!"
"It's okay. I think Mr. Meilan just gave me a special greeting and has no other meaning. The light elves told me so."
Clinhilde walked to Roland and patted his shoulder to comfort him.
Roland then waved his hand, and the soldiers put away their weapons in an orderly manner but still did not lift the siege.
Siegfried breathed a sigh of relief. He had already prepared for the worst.
"Please forgive me for being rude, Your Highness. This is a hand-kissing ceremony that has recently become popular in the Orpheus Empire. Unexpectedly, it is not common in Morn."
Siegfried was making nonsense seriously, but in fact he didn't even know where the Orpheus Empire was.
Kelin Xied covered her mouth and chuckled:
"The atmosphere of the empire is still so open."
Although this sudden episode was thrilling, it quickly brought the two of them closer together.
After a few words of greeting, Clinhide straightened her expression and asked:
"Mr. Siegfried, Katarina, is this friend of mine really here with you?"
Siegfried looked around the area and saw a certain Pucheng scout who had already taken advantage of the chaos and fled far away.
He sneered, pointed in the direction of the gardener and said:
